_comment: Strong variant of scenario_missed_detections.json (target realism report, Part I): IDENTICAL to the published tracker-report baseline except amplitude raised 0.0006 -> 0.0009 (+3.5 dB mean SNR). Provides a second operating point for the fade-correlation x max_coast sweep where the steady target is comfortably above threshold, so fading cells have dynamic range to show the CLEAN boundary moving with frame_corr. No published baseline exists at this amplitude; the sweep's steady rows serve as the in-experiment control.
